status: registered before any E7 training or evaluation
question: When a second Sentinel-2 phenomenon (solar farm) is added so the sensor no longer identifies the phenomenon, does the frozen-OlmoEarth projector reader (a) still answer each phenomenon from the embedding and beat a same-budget blind reader, and (b) answer the asked question rather than flag any anomaly (solar question on landslide tiles, pre vs post event)? How does a non-LLM head trained on the same batches compare?

data.landslide: sentinel_qa_train_v0 / sentinel_qa_v0_1 Q1 (S2 pair); test regions reported separately (hiroshima 186 tiles, indonesia 6)
data.flood: flood_qa_v0 train / test (S1 pair, synthetic -24/-12 d dates as in E2; exposed events)
data.solar: e7_items_v1 (items sha256 c4aa5bf0a82c80fde36f04e2e48a80c707185882e410c5f851918e3e73b54ab2): task2_cache OlmoEarth v1 Base single embedding; yes = solar pixels >= 1%, no = 0; train regions task2_fold2..7 (222 pos / 2,231 neg), test task2_fold0+fold1 (96 pos / 711 neg). v0 (fold0 only, 47 pos) was superseded before any model run
data.cross: solar question on landslide tiles, single S2 date: pre-event (first date of the positive item) and post-event (second date); gold no. train 1,036 / test 384

training: per epoch 4,234 items (E2 budget): 1/3 landslide, 1/3 flood, 1/3 solar question (half solar chips balanced yes/no, half cross items), sampled with replacement, 3 epochs, batch 8. Reader/blind: projector as E2, AdamW 1e-4. Head: LayerNorm-MLP on mean-pooled [first, second, second-first] + question one-hot, BCE, AdamW 1e-3, same item schedule per seed. Seeds 1,2,3
evaluation: reader: real_all, swap_within_tile (landslide, flood), swap_cross_tile (all three), zero_embedding; blind: real_all; head: same plan as reader. Greedy, max_new_tokens 16

primary_verdicts.reads_<phenomenon>: for landslide, flood, solar separately: in >= 2 of 3 seeds, content control >= 0.10 with tile-bootstrap CI lower > 0 (landslide/flood: d_swap within tile; solar: d_cross) AND reader balanced_acc - blind balanced_acc >= 0.05
primary_verdicts.cross_question: anomaly_driven if in >= 2 seeds the reader's cross FPR(post) - FPR(pre) >= 0.10 with tile-bootstrap CI lower > 0; question_specific if in >= 2 seeds overall cross FPR <= 0.10 and |post - pre| < 0.05; otherwise unclear
primary_verdicts.invalid: parse failure > 10% in any arm of any seed, or a crash (reported, not re-run with changed settings)

descriptive_only: reader - head balanced accuracy per phenomenon and seed (no threshold, no equivalence claim)
landslide balanced accuracy per test region
comparison with E2 landslide seed spread (balanced sampling effect; not causal because the solar task is also added)
what_this_does_not_show: date use (flood dates stay synthetic here; see planned E9)
compute: GPU0 (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0) only if no other process; one process holds it for head, reader and blind runs
